description: Mark one failed check on the business's latest linked website report as not applying, with the owner's reason in their own words (10 to 300 characters): it then counts as passed in the business's own score, which says how many points come from overrides. Never shown on public pages and never changes where OnHand ranks the business. Saving again replaces the reason; remove_visibility_override undoes it. Ask the owner first and use the reason they give; never write one for them. Owner or admin. Returns check_id, reason and set_at, or error with a message. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: override_visibility_check
title: Override a website check
